notes.title: Patch Note: For the Crown 1.0 Pre-Release
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The final update for For the Crown 1.0 Pre-Release is complete!

A lot has changed since the last update. I’ve fixed many bugs, added new buildings, and improved game balance.

One of the biggest changes is how guards work. They no longer block pawns from entering the castle. Instead, they now give traders a crown and double their value. This makes the game flow much smoother and removes unnecessary slowdowns if your production chain isn’t fully set up yet.

The building unlock order has also been adjusted, making it much easier for new players to follow the production chains. And if that wasn’t enough, I had to re-record almost all of the video tutorials!

Building prices have been halved, so you can progress faster at the start without waiting around like in an idle game.

But my favorite new feature? Pontoons! You can now transport pawns across water, allowing travel between islands. Plus, bombs can now destroy trees and mushrooms, giving you even more space to expand your kingdom.

I hope you enjoy everything I’ve built. 

Cheers!
Gierki Dev

notes.title: Patch Note: Dynamic Difficulty and Campaign Content - Part 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’m really excited to share the latest updates for For the Crown with you! Since the last update, a lot has changed, and I’ve made some exciting improvements to enhance your gaming experience.

New Features:
Dynamic Difficulty:
I’ve developed a dynamic difficulty system that adjusts the challenge of each map to your abilities. This way, you should have a better sense of accomplishment and be motivated to push beyond your limits!

Revised Building Unlocks:
The order in which you unlock buildings has been revamped. I wanted to avoid overwhelming you with too many options at once. Starting with Tier 1 will help you learn the game’s basics more comfortably before diving deeper.

Visual Overhaul:
Buildings now "pop" when they spawn a pawn. This makes it easier to see which buildings are functioning normally.

Editor Expansion:
I’ve added new tools that allow you to create maps quickly and unleash your creativity!

New Maps:

There are now 16 new campaign maps that grow larger and more complex from level to level.
Additionally, I’ve prepared 5 new custom maps for you to explore.
Links to Discord and YouTube:
To further connect the community, I’ve added icons that link directly to my Discord and YouTube channels. I’d love to see you there!

I’m really looking forward to hearing what you think about these changes! Come join me on Discord to get to know me and chat about the game.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: For the Crown - Tutorial Update V3.8.5
notes.content:
The "For the Crown" V3.8.5 update brings several exciting features, improvements, and fixes to enhance the overall gaming experience. Let's dive into the key aspects of this update:


Changelog:

[list]
[*] Added Infinity Item: Buildings no longer require resources (only in the editor).
[*] Added Video Tutorial window.
[*] Added 31 tutorial recordings.
[*] Added Save System for Video Tutorials (they only play once per version update).
[*] Added Save System for building unlocks for persistent unlocks.
[*] Added reset buttons in the main menu for tutorials and building unlocks.

[*] Changed: Level 4 castles have no guards due to confusion feedback.

[*] Rebalanced walking distance for wooden and stone roads.
[*] Rebalanced walking distance for trampoline springs.

[*] Fixed sound issue on fresh game – it was too loud.
[*] Fixed Purple Tier Building/Pawns values, thanks to feedback.
[*] Fixed issue where the king produced income when pawns got catapulted in his face; players have to use the gates now.
[*] Updated the main menu background map.
[/list]

Rule your kingdom wisely with these enhancements!

notes.title: 👑 For the Crown - New Year, Update Teaser 👑
notes.content:
🏰 Happy New Year, Sovereign Rulers! 🎉

As we bid farewell to the old and welcome the new, may your kingdoms flourish and your reigns be ever more glorious in this auspicious year.

📜 Tutorial Unveiled:
Embark on your royal journey with newfound wisdom! Our upcoming update introduces an immersive tutorial, guiding you through the intricacies of kingdom management. Whether you're a seasoned ruler or a fresh-faced monarch, master the art of governance and lead your realm to glory!

🎙️ Voiceovers Fit for Royalty:
Hear ye, hear ye! The tutorial shall not be the only one regaling you with tales of the kingdom. Brace yourselves for a fully voiced experience, where every dialogue, every piece of advice, and every jest is delivered with the regal charm of voice acting. Let the comedic tones resonate through your kingdom as you make decisions that will echo through the annals of history!

💣 Bombs Unleashed - Now for Free!
In a grand gesture of goodwill, we've decided to make the explosive side of ruling absolutely free! Arm your kingdom with bombs without denting your treasury. The power is in your hands, and now, the bombs are too!

🔧 Bug Banishment: A Glitch-Free Realm Awaits!
To the vigilant rulers who have reported anomalies in our realm, we extend our gratitude. Bugfixes abound, promising a smoother and more enjoyable rule.

Prepare to witness these grand updates, and may your crown gleam ever brighter in this prosperous New Year! 🎉👑
